subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should OpenClaw accept this experimental persisted Claw status/removal lifecycle in core before the stacked package and export feature series is otherwise settled?
rationale: The patch is not a narrow bug fix: it establishes a core-owned ownership ledger and removal policy spanning config, files, sessions, plugins, and skills. Code review cannot determine whether that product boundary belongs in core rather than a plugin or later RFC-backed implementation.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental core lifecycle
options.body: Accept the core direction, then require complete branch-specific live cleanup proof and normal stacked-PR review before landing.

options.title: Pause the lifecycle slice
options.body: Defer this persisted status/remove surface until the RFC and ownership model have an explicit maintainer-approved landing plan.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental core lifecycle
recommendation.body: Accept the core direction, then require complete branch-specific live cleanup proof and normal stacked-PR review before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Their RFC review raised the removal-ownership contract this PR is designed to satisfy.
